description: This is a test class for the AnySoftKeyboard application, specifically testing keyboard switching functionality, including mode changes, caching, configuration changes, and UI dialogs.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardSwitchingTest
classes.description: Test class for keyboard switching and mode change functionalities in AnySoftKeyboard.

methods.name: testSwitchToSymbols
methods.description: Tests switching to different symbol keyboard modes and back to alphabet.

methods.name: testCreateOrUseCacheKeyboard
methods.description: Verifies that keyboard instances are cached and reused appropriately.

methods.name: verifyCreatedGenericKeyboard
methods.description: Helper method to verify the current keyboard is a GenericKeyboard with expected id and mode.

methods.name: testInvalidateCachedLayoutsWhenInputModeChanges
methods.description: Ensures cached keyboard layouts are invalidated when input mode changes.

methods.name: testCreateOrUseCacheKeyboardWhen16KeysEnabled
methods.description: Tests caching behavior when 16 keys mode is enabled.

methods.name: testModeSwitch
methods.description: Tests switching between alphabet and symbol modes.

methods.name: testModeSwitchLoadsDictionary
methods.description: Verifies that dictionary setup is triggered on mode switch.

methods.name: testOnKeyboardSetLoadsDictionary
methods.description: Checks that setting a new keyboard loads the dictionary appropriately.

methods.name: testModeSwitchesOnConfigurationChange
methods.description: Tests that keyboard mode switches correctly on configuration changes like orientation.

methods.name: testCanNotSwitchWhenInLockedMode
methods.description: Verifies that switching is disabled when input is in locked mode.

methods.name: testShowSelectedKeyboardForURLField
methods.description: Tests automatic keyboard selection based on input field type, including URL fields.

methods.name: testShowPreviousKeyboardIfInternetKeyboardPrefIdIsInvalid
methods.description: Ensures fallback to previous keyboard if internet keyboard preference is invalid.

methods.name: testLanguageDialogShowLanguagesAndSettings
methods.description: Verifies the language selection dialog shows correct options.

methods.name: testLanguageDialogSwitchLanguage
methods.description: Tests switching language via the language selection dialog.

methods.name: testLanguageDialogGoToSettings
methods.description: Verifies that selecting 'Setup languages...' opens the correct settings activity.
